scenario: 查店铺域名/币种 — info get 只读
input: 看一下店铺现在的主域名和币种设置

semantic_rubric: read-only shop info get; no update emitted
reports domain and currency from .data fields, nothing fabricated

notes: GET /shop; optional fields query param may narrow the response.

scenario: 改店铺客服邮箱 — 先 get 拿 shop_id, 再 update 只发这一个字段
input: 把店铺的客服邮箱改成 support@brand.com

semantic_rubric: resolves shop_id first via shop info get (shop_id is a required path param the user cannot know)
sends only customer_email — partial update, does not resend or touch other shop attributes
body nested under the required shop object; restates before the write

notes: PATCH /shop/{shop_id}; body {"shop":{"customer_email":...}} — only sent fields are written. Multi-step: get → update.

scenario: 公网 URL 上传到素材库 — happy path
input: 把 https://example.com/banner.png 传到店铺素材库

semantic_rubric: --folder omitted (defaults to all_upload) without asking
knows the upload is an async TASK — may follow up with shop files task to check status
uses shop +upload-file (media library), not products images (product-attached)

scenario: 要传本地文件 — API 只收公网 URL, 必须降级询问而不是编造 URL
input: 把我电脑里的 banner.png 上传到素材库

semantic_rubric: recognizes +upload-file takes PUBLIC URLs, NOT local files (stated verbatim in its --help)
does not fabricate a URL for the local file and does not emit a write
explains the limitation and asks for a public link (or proposes hosting the file somewhere reachable first)

notes: Degradation case. Help text: 'Submit a file upload task (takes public URLs, NOT local files)'.

scenario: 浏览素材库 — files list, 默认 folder
input: 看看素材库里都有哪些文件

semantic_rubric: folder defaults to all_upload — not set, not asked
any jq extraction starts at .data, without -r

scenario: 开启密码保护但没给密码 — 必须问密码, 不能编造

semantic_rubric: asks for the storefront password instead of inventing one
the eventual write is shop info update with shop.password_protection, shop_id resolved via shop info get
treats turning protection on as high-impact (locks the storefront): --dry-run + restate before the write

notes: PATCH /shop/{shop_id}; password must not be empty while protection is enabled.

scenario: 改订单编号前缀 — 是店铺设置, 只发 order_number.prefix
input: 把订单编号前缀改成 SP

semantic_rubric: routes to shop (a store setting), not to orders
resolves shop_id via shop info get; sends only order_number.prefix — no suffix, number_type or order_id_type

notes: PATCH /shop/{shop_id}; omitted fields keep their current value.

scenario: 关掉评论通知 — 只发这一个开关, 包在 notifications 里
input: 关掉店铺的评论通知，其他通知不动

semantic_rubric: not a webhook subscription — the merchant's own alert switch
sends only review_enabled; the other switches are omitted and kept

notes: PUT /shop/notifications; body wrapper notifications is required.

scenario: 开启客户隐私 — 一个开关同时管 GDPR 和 CCPA, 发 customer_privacy.enabled
input: 给店铺打开客户隐私保护

semantic_rubric: resolves shop_id via shop info get; sends customer_privacy.enabled true
mentions that this turns on GDPR and CCPA together
does not try to write the read-only privacy app fields

notes: PATCH /shop/{shop_id}; customer_privacy.enabled writes GDPR and CCPA with the same value (one switch, as in the admin).

scenario: 只开 GDPR 不动 CCPA — 没有单独的开关, 必须说明并询问, 不能直接写
input: 给店铺打开 GDPR，CCPA 先别动

semantic_rubric: recognizes customer privacy is one switch: customer_privacy.enabled turns GDPR and CCPA on together, there is no GDPR-only switch
does not write before the user agrees that CCPA will be turned on too
does not invent gdpr_enabled / ccpa_enabled fields

notes: Degradation case. schema shop.info.update: customer_privacy has only enabled (plus read-only app fields).

scenario: 改店铺时区为东京 — 传 IANA 名 Asia/Tokyo 或内部码 +0900 都对
input: 把店铺时区改成东京时间

semantic_rubric: timezone is Asia/Tokyo or +0900 — not an offset like +09:00 or a display name
sends only timezone; resolves shop_id via shop info get

notes: PATCH /shop/{shop_id}; totoro accepts a supported IANA name or the internal code, stores the code.
